Monnik Monday Recovery Ride

Louisville, KY · Schnitzelburg

Beginner friendly

Monnik Monday Recovery Ride is a road and social group ride in Louisville, KY. It meets every Monday, 6:15 pm sharp, year-round, starting at Monnik Beer Company. Expect about 10–15 miles, 10–15 mph, actual recovery pace.

About the Monnik Monday Recovery Ride group ride

A really slow recovery ride from Monnik in Schnitzelburg. Ten to fifteen miles at ten to fifteen mph, then a discounted pint back at the brewery.
